criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: Location-Location
categories.definition: A spatial relation where one location is contained within, part of, or situated in another location.

categories.name: Location-Waterbody
categories.definition: A spatial relation where a water body flows into, is situated in, or borders another water body or location.

categories.name: Location-Mountain
categories.definition: A spatial relation where a mountain or landform is part of a larger mountain range or geographical region.

categories.name: Person-Location
categories.definition: A relation where a person is associated with a location through birth, residence, travel, or position.

categories.name: Person-Organization
categories.definition: A relation where a person is a member, employee, leader, or representative of an organization or group.

categories.name: Person-Role
categories.definition: A relation where a person holds a specific title, office, or professional role.

categories.name: Person-Person
categories.definition: A familial, professional, or social relation between two individuals.

categories.name: Creative Work-Creator
categories.definition: A relation where a creative work is authored, directed, composed, or created by a person or group.

categories.name: Creative Work-Publisher
categories.definition: A relation where a work is released, published, or distributed by a company or label.

categories.name: Creative Work-Genre
categories.definition: A relation where a work, group, or person belongs to a specific artistic style, genre, or category.

categories.name: Creative Work-Work
categories.definition: A relation between two creative works, such as being part of a series, a sequel, or a version.

categories.name: Organization-Organization
categories.definition: A relation where an organization is a subsidiary, part of, merged with, or acquired by another organization.

categories.name: Organization-Location
categories.definition: A relation where an organization is based in, operates in, or serves a specific location.

categories.name: Event-Location
categories.definition: A relation where an event takes place at or is hosted by a specific location or venue.

categories.name: Event-Participant
categories.definition: A relation where a person or entity participates in, competes in, or wins an event.

categories.name: Event-Organization
categories.definition: A relation where an event is organized by, affiliated with, or part of an organization's activities.

categories.name: Product-Developer
categories.definition: A relation where a product, software, or vehicle is developed, manufactured, or owned by a company.

categories.name: Product-Platform
categories.definition: A relation where a software product or game is designed to run on a specific operating system or platform.

categories.name: Award-Nominee
categories.definition: A relation where a person or work is nominated for or wins an award or honor.

categories.name: Concept-Concept
categories.definition: A relation between abstract concepts, such as one being a type of, part of, or equivalent to another.

categories.name: Entity-Nationality
categories.definition: A relation where a person, group, or entity is identified with a specific country, nationality, or ethnic group.

categories.name: Instrument-Musician
categories.definition: A relation where a person plays a specific musical instrument.

categories.name: Infrastructure-Location
categories.definition: A relation where a transportation route, facility, or structure is located in or connects geographic points.

categories.name: Administrative-Division
categories.definition: A relation where a geographic entity is a type of or belongs to a specific administrative or political division.

categories.name: Heritage-Registry
categories.definition: A relation where a site or object is listed on a historical or heritage registry.
